info.name: RetailX — Android API
info.description:
Full /api/v1 REST surface for the RetailX inventory/purchase/sales/POS platform, intended for the Android app's Bearer-token flow (see Docs/MOBILE_API_GUIDE.md). Run 'Auth > Login' first — it auto-saves access_token/refresh_token as collection variables used by every other request. For Super Admin endpoints, run 'Super Admin > Login' first instead (separate token/identity).

Response envelope: {success, data, message} or {success:false, error:{code, message, details}}. Only products/sales/purchases list endpoints return {items, pagination}; other list endpoints return a plain array in data.

Permission SALE.VIEW. Always send `channel` matching whatever value this same cart will use for POST /sales (POS/ONLINE/MARKETPLACE/PHONE) — an extra charge restricted to one channel (see GET /extra-charges -> applicableChannels) is only included in the preview when channel matches; an unrestricted charge (applicableChannels: null) always applies regardless of channel. Omitting channel silently understates the total by any channel-restricted charge that would otherwise apply to the real sale.
If a warehouse-scoped user omits warehouseId, the server forces it to their own warehouse.
No list/GET endpoint exists for stock adjustments.
Source warehouse is only chosen at approve time.
